item.title: Update 1.4.2 is Coming Week of July 27
item.description:
Another update is around the corner for Civilization VII, featuring a handful of improvements and couple major changes all about deepening your diplomatic strategy: 

  • Expanded Peace Deals: You can now offer Gold and Influence in addition to trading Settlements. We've also updated the UI so you can temporarily dismiss a peace offer to survey the map before making your final decision.

item.title: PUBG Global Series Circuit 3: Everything You Need To Know!
item.description:
Hello, PUBG Esports fans!

After two circuits in Seoul, the PUBG Global Series is moving to Shanghai, China. PGS Circuit 3, featuring PGS 7, PGS 8, and PGS 9, will take place across three weeks from August 5 to 23.
